run_openedai_tts_server: run the OpenedAI Speech API server on a specified host and port with optional XTTS device and unload timer
generate_speech_streaming: generate streaming speech audio from text using the /v1/audio/speech endpoint with model, voice, format, and speed parameters
build_ffmpeg_args: build ffmpeg command-line arguments to convert raw PCM audio to mp3, opus, aac, flac, wav, or pcm format
preprocess_text_input: preprocess raw text input by applying regex substitutions from config/pre_process_map.yaml and stripping whitespace
map_voice_to_speaker: map a voice name to speaker configuration from config/voice_to_speaker.yaml for a given model
